payload.core_mechanism_summary: Greedy bit-by-bit processing from LSB to MSB: for each bit set in n, use a box of that size if available; otherwise split the next larger box, counting splits. Excess smaller boxes are combined into larger ones via carry.
payload.rationale: The algorithm makes locally optimal choices: using the smallest available larger box to minimize splits, which is optimal by an exchange argument. It does not use DP or complex bit manipulation beyond counting powers of two.
